title: Tillman and Avery band, the Buzzards and meeting Dick Allen
summary: The band played for the Buzzards, Lions and at Tyler's in Audubon Park, where he met Dick Allen; they cut a tape with Dude Lewis on trumpet.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And how long did you play with that band? Joe Everett.

Joe Everett. Joe Everett. Oh we held that band together around about. Well I guess I might as well say up until when Joe died. Cause we broke up his band and then I made up a band and taken him in the band with me and we named it the Tillman and Everett band. But we was playing you know up until his death. He still had that band but we both was working with different bands right on. Cause I mean in this music field if you don't work with different bands you'll never make it. It's not enough night life here for one band to you know just stay together and play together all the time.
Your band was Joe Angry was up at the buzzards club there on the enunciation or someplace?

Joe Well yeah we played for the buzzards so a lot for about it. The first club we played yeah we played for the buzzards we played for the Eleanor's. We played for the Lions and we used to play up in Audubon Park at Tyler's. You ever heard of Tyler's? Joe Oh yeah. Joe Well that's the first place I met Dick Allen. I was playing at Tyler's. Joe And I encouraged Dick to come here he was in the service thing you know. He had us to make a little cut for him. We had.
I remember he made a tape of that.

Joe Yeah. Joe Well they had dude Foster Lewis was playing trumpet on that at that time. And we cut that tape for Dick. Well he left the enemy on the way to California somewhere and I think his friend died. Joe Well when he got out the service he decided to come down here he wanted to see a carnival. He had never seen a carnival. Joe So I told him I said well Dick I think if you come down there you'll like it. Joe Well sure enough he can and he like it enough to make it at home. Joe He stayed down there. Joe That's why whenever he be making them talks he said well Tillman is part of the cause I'm here in Yorlin. Joe He encouraged me to come down here. Joe Which I'm glad to see him down here. Joe You know what I mean he did a whole lot of good things for me. Joe Since he been around here being a stranger in this town you know. Joe So all those kind of things have to be considered you know.
